entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, agent ID 401. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, um, I need to return something. I think. I'm just so confused by the whole thing. My name is Alex Chen.
I can certainly look into that for you, Alex. I'm pulling up your account now... I see an order for the AeroStride cycling shoes. Is that the item you're calling about?
Yes, the cycling shoes. They're just not right. The website said they were great, but I... I don't know.
I understand. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's... I don't know if it's a fault? My feet hurt so much after I ride, I keep getting terrible blisters. And the things on the bottom... the cleats? I can't seem to get them to work right. It's all so overwhelming. Can't you just help me? I just want to send them back for a refund.
Of course, Alex. I'm sorry to hear they're causing you blisters, that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the policy for you. One moment.
Okay... I hope it's okay. It's been a little while.

Alright, thank you for your patience. I see you received the shoes 54 days ago. According to our policy, standard items like these cycling shoes are eligible for return within 90 days. So, you are well within the window. I can process this refund for you right now.
Oh! Really? That's... that's a huge relief. Thank you so much. I was so worried it would be a problem.

Not a problem at all. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file. Just print that out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the item, your full refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Wow, that's great. Thank you, Diana. You've been a big help.
You're very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thanks again!
Have a wonderful day. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
